data-passback-auto-start.description: Starts the widget when the page loads. Only the exact value "false" disables startup; the existing global opt-out also applies.

data-passback-corner.description: Screen corner where the launcher sits.

data-passback-launcher.description: Whether the launcher button is shown; any value other than "hidden" shows it.

data-passback-hotkey.description: Hotkey that starts marking. Either "off" or modifiers plus one letter or digit, joined by "+", and requiring alt, ctrl or meta. An invalid value keeps the existing fallback.

data-passback-hide-hotkey.description: Hotkey that hides or shows marks. Uses the same syntax and "off" behavior as the marking hotkey; an invalid value keeps its existing fallback.

data-passback-theme.description: Widget color theme. With "auto" the theme follows the existing page-background rule.

data-passback-main.description: Main color override. Empty means no override; a valid override is a color written as #rrggbb.

data-passback-secondary.description: Secondary color override. Empty means no override; a valid override is a color written as #rrggbb.

data-passback-chunk.description: Collector chunk URL. When omitted, the URL is derived as collector.js beside the selected widget script when possible.

data-passback-endpoint.description: Relay ingest URL. When omitted, no relay endpoint is supplied.

data-passback-screenshots.description: Opts in to screenshots. Only the exact value "true" opts in, and it still needs the existing chunk and upload configuration.

data-passback-shot.description: Screenshot chunk URL. When omitted, the URL is derived as shot.js beside the widget script when possible.

data-passback-shot-upload.description: Local screenshot upload URL, used only when there is no relay endpoint; with a relay endpoint the upload URL is derived from it.

data-passback-panel.description: Panel chunk URL, trimmed before use. Empty leaves the local Inbox tool unavailable.
